Specification: This module specifies a fast mutual exclusion algorithm with two distinct process classes, generated from a PlusCal algorithm named FastMutex. Processes in 1..M execute one control-flow copy and processes in (M+1)..N execute a second structurally similar copy, coordinating through shared variables x, y, and b to compete for entry to a critical section. The specification defines initialization, per-process actions, the overall next-state relation, a standard temporal specification with weak fairness for each process class, a mutual exclusion invariant asserting that no two distinct processes are simultaneously in the critical section, and a liveness property requiring that some process enters the critical section infinitely often.
